name: get_redot_scene_tree
description: Read the Redot/Godot scene tree reported by an owned launch's loopback engine-debugger protocol peer. Results identify their cooperative protocol source and are paged.

refresh.description: Ask the responsive engine for a fresh tree before a later poll.

name: inspect_redot_object
description: Select a Redot/Godot scene object and read its engine-reported script, properties, and Signal-valued properties. Object IDs may be decimal strings to preserve 64-bit values.

name: set_redot_profiling
description: Start or stop the cooperative engine frame/function profiler. Starting clears retained timing and native samples; stopping retains them. Does not resume the target.

name: set_redot_capture_status
description: Publish explicit sampling-client progress or a startup failure for the Time pane. Does not start profiling, interrupt, or resume the target. Diagnostic text is capped at 512 bytes.

name: get_redot_profile
description: Read bounded frame timings, select a process frame, and drill down through script costs to native/script stop samples joined by the engine frame number. Shared script timing is not per-node timing.

name: capture_redot_sample
description: Retain the current stopped native/script stack with process/physics frame counters and owner object IDs read through DWARF. Does not interrupt or resume; explicit stop sampling perturbs engine wall timings.
